Which heart failure patients are not on all four GDMT pillars? Definition: Heart failure = any I50.* diagnosis on a condition record, an encounter diagnosis (EHR or ADT) or a payer claim; alive at as_of (no CCLF8 death date on or before as_of). Pillars: (1) evidence-based HF beta blocker (carvedilol, metoprolol succinate, bisoprolol); (2) ACE inhibitor, ARB or sacubitril/valsartan; (3) MRA (spironolactone, eplerenone); (4) SGLT2 inhibitor. On a pillar = active on the medication list, or a fill whose supply covers any of the 120 days before as_of. List patients missing one or more pillars.
